name: Speculative Design
description: Speculative design versus critical design, design fiction, emerging technologies (AI, AR/VR, climate tech, etc.), systems thinking, inter-disciplinary research, trends-mapping, worldbuilding, narrative design, experiential prototyping, interaction design, exhibition and public engagement, etc. Through a practice-based approach, students will experience various stages of the speculative design process learning to convert abstract future visions into experiential prototypes culminating into an exhibition.
